svg.title: Held-out 95th-percentile location errors and distant-source mistake fractions vary across delay and noise, with all fits retained.
svg.desc: Each condition retains 64 fixed held-out parameter sites and 32 paired independent noise vectors per site (2,048 fits). The upper statistic is a finite-benchmark 95th percentile, not a confidence limit; lower fractions count distant location errors at scale 0.2. No population confidence intervals are inferred from Sobol sites. Unsuccessful numerical optimizers remain in the denominators. Some local/extended-E curves overlap intentionally because they select the same physical layout; this is not replication evidence.
